_why: forge station catalog overlay: every station-only tool and skill in the commons catalog scope (tools/**/*.py, .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md, .claude/workflows/*). Workflows are added by the equip block with their files.

tools/station/forge_check.py.title: forge_check

.claude/skills/tool-trial/SKILL.md.title: tool-trial
.claude/skills/tool-trial/SKILL.md.purpose: N >= 5 frozen tasks without/with a tool, blind-graded, failed runs read; verdict promote/park

.claude/skills/evo-guard/SKILL.md.title: evo-guard

.claude/skills/kit-maintain/SKILL.md.title: kit-maintain
.claude/skills/kit-maintain/SKILL.md.purpose: repin report, sync --check and listing budgets across branches; a licence change stops

.claude/skills/re-legal-gate/SKILL.md.title: re-legal-gate

tools/station/telemetry_plan.py.title: telemetry_plan

.claude/skills/noise-floor/SKILL.md.title: noise-floor

.claude/skills/design-it-twice/SKILL.md.title: design-it-twice
.claude/skills/design-it-twice/SKILL.md.purpose: two radically different interfaces, a depth/leverage/locality table, then pick

.claude/skills/ci-suite-audit/SKILL.md.title: ci-suite-audit
.claude/skills/ci-suite-audit/SKILL.md.purpose: planted defect per check proves it can fail; cost per job; cut only overlapping checks

.claude/skills/skill-route-intake/SKILL..title: skill-route-intake
.claude/skills/skill-route-intake/SKILL..purpose: freeze keywords before prompts for a new upstream's skills; selftest-routes; surface

.claude/skills/skill-author/SKILL.md.title: skill-author

.claude/workflows/trial-run.js.title: trial-run
.claude/workflows/trial-run.js.purpose: freeze N>=5 tasks, noise floor, A/B arms, blind grade, verdict + TRIAL row

.claude/workflows/optimize-loop.js.title: optimize-loop

.claude/workflows/wiki-gen.js.title: wiki-gen

.claude/workflows/reverse.js.title: reverse
.claude/workflows/reverse.js.purpose: RE-GATE row first, REA in a run-tree, findings each with evidence

.claude/workflows/intake-run.js.title: intake-run
.claude/workflows/intake-run.js.purpose: pin/licence/agent-file/telemetry census, placement, ingest.py, route + surface skills

.claude/workflows/arch-review.js.title: arch-review
.claude/workflows/arch-review.js.purpose: two blind designers, a judge with the improve-codebase-architecture lens, pick

.claude/workflows/kit-repin.js.title: kit-repin
.claude/workflows/kit-repin.js.purpose: repin report, certain tests, record with applied: no; the apply is the operator's

tools/station/setup_tool.py.title: setup_tool
tools/station/setup_tool.py.purpose: one command per forge tool (rea/evo/openwiki/projectatlas): prereqs, pin, run tree, install at the pin, telemetry off, keys, smoke; --check = start gate

.claude/workflows/setup.js.title: setup
.claude/workflows/setup.js.purpose: runs setup_tool.py for one tool (or all) and verifies it with setup_tool.py --check
